metadata.title: Lo-Fi Scrapbook Portrait with Beaded Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A grainy, sepia-toned portrait of a young woman with a torn-edge border, centered on a clean white background. A physical beaded bracelet with purple, white, and black beads is layered over the image, appearing to float with a soft drop shadow. The composition is framed by wide-tracked, typewriter-style text at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The torn paper edge creates a tactile contrast against the sterile white background.
The high-saturation purple beads provide the only vibrant color against the muted sepia portrait.
The wide letter-spacing of the text balances the verticality of the central image.
coreInvariants: Torn, irregular edges on the central image block.
Monospaced, typewriter-style typography with extreme tracking.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The portrait is centrally located, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The beaded bracelet acts as a secondary focal point, drawing the eye in a circular motion around the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, move down to the subject's face, follow the curve of the beads, and land on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous white margins surround the central collage, creating a clean, gallery-like feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/Pure white background for negative space.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated sepia and charcoal tones for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep indigo/purple for the beads and typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the image contrasted with high-value white and high-saturation purple accents.

letterConstructionRules: Slab serifs with irregular, ink-bleed edges.
Lower-case only for a casual, personal feel.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'b' and 'k' characters show slight ink-spread distortion to mimic physical stamping.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both top and bottom text to maintain symmetry.
graphicDevices: Drop shadow on beads for 3D effect

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tactile, analog feel of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, sepia-toned portrait of a woman with long hair, masked with a torn-paper edge effect. Place this on a white background. Overlay a string of purple and white beads in a loose 'S' curve with a subtle drop shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase typewriter text in deep purple at the top and bottom margins, using wide letter-spacing to span the width of the central image.

verificationChecks: Is the text lowercase and widely spaced?
Does the central image have a torn-paper border?
Is the color palette restricted to sepia, white, and purple?
Do the beads have a realistic drop shadow?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the purple text matches the purple beads.
Check that the torn edge looks organic, not geometric.
Verify the grain is consistent across the portrait but absent from the white background.
Confirm the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Subject] in [Sepia Grain] with [Torn Edge Mask] on [White Background], framed by [Wide-Tracked Typewriter Text] in [Accent Color].
